propositions: rebar comment silently stores flag-like tokens (e.g. --body-file, --body) as the comment body instead of rejecting them, and exits 0 without warning
when a positional body argument begins with a dash, it is accepted as the body value, while the actual intended content in a subsequent argument is discarded
two independent sessions each lost substantial work records because comments were stored as 11-byte or 6-byte flag strings rather than intended markdown content
the failure is undetectable at write time: exit code is 0, no stderr is printed, and len(comments) increases, so downstream verification fails confusingly on missing content
the fix must guard all positional-body commands (comment, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) and provide -- as an escape hatch for values that legitimately start with -
